name: Casefile Test World
summary: A tiny market town used only to exercise the mystery/cases engine. A pawnbroker lies dead in his shop, and the town wants an answer.

locations.name: The Commons
locations.description: A muddy square between the pawnshop and the tavern, a stocks and a dry well at its centre.

locations.name: The Pawnshop
locations.description: A cramped room of pledged oddments behind a scarred counter. The broker lies where he fell.

locations.name: The Sign of the Anchor
locations.description: A low, smoke-dark tavern that hears everything the town says and keeps most of it.

npcs.name: Reeve Alda
npcs.summary: The town reeve, first to reach the body.
npcs.persona: Plain-spoken, tired, and fair. She wants the thing settled and the town quiet.

npcs.name: Corin
npcs.summary: A tavern regular who was out in the square at dusk.
npcs.persona: Nervous and reluctant, but honest once pressed.

npcs.name: Hedwyn
npcs.summary: A cheerful debtor of the dead broker, always ready to point a finger elsewhere.
npcs.persona: Affable, glib, quick to name the rival two streets over.
